svg.text: UNIVERSAL TWO-TIER HIERARCHICAL VERIFICATION & MILESTONE RATCHET ARCHITECTURE
L0-Macro Compositional Milestone AND-DAG & Git Commit Ratchet × L0-Micro Generalized V13 AB-MCTS on Reflection Beam-1.0-501B + DFlash2
Scales from 5-Minute Bug Fixes (<200 LoC) to Multi-Day Full-System Builds (5,000–100,000+ LoC) with Zero Context Rot or L1 Falsifier Overload
TIER 1 — LAYER L0-MACRO: COMPOSITIONAL MILESTONE AND-DAG & GIT COMMIT RATCHET
Decomposes 100K-LoC Builds into Topological <500-LoC Milestones (M₁ ≺ M₂ ≺ ... ≺ Mₖ)
• 0 diff lines exposed to M₂..Mₖ audits
• Base Commit: HEADₖ₋₁ (M₁..Mₖ₋₁ safe in Git)
• Active Delta: git diff HEADₖ₋₁ (< 500 LoC)
• GEN reset returns to HEADₖ₋₁ (never wipes M₁..Mₖ₋₁)
• Dispatches L0-Micro V13 AB-MCTS Episode Below ↓
TIER 2 — LAYER L0-MICRO & L1-A: SCOPED AB-MCTS OR-TREE ON MILESTONE Mₖ DELTA
Zero Repo-Specific Hints | Clean <4K-Token Ledger | Configurable diff_bloat_threshold
1. Layer L1-A: Scoped Recon Probe (0–6 Turns)
• Maps Mₖ target_files + interfaces from HEADₖ₋₁
• Returns <800-tok ReconBrief; raw grep dumps GC'd
• Never scans 100K-LoC history (bounded to Mₖ scope)
b1 [Consumer / Local]: Direct feature / symptom fix
b3 [Codebase Symmetry]: Sibling class & interface parity
• Samples θ_a ~ Beta(α_a, β_a) across Mₖ checkpoints
• GEN(b_j): Widen from clean HEADₖ₋₁ (preserves M₁..Mₖ₋₁)
• Negative Evidence Ledger blocks repeated dead-ends
TIER 3 — LAYER L2: EPHEMERAL CLEAN-CONTEXT EXECUTORS (BEAM-1.0-501B + DFLASH2)
Greenfield File Creation (allow_new_files=True) | 0.8s–3.5s/turn with 8-Token Speculative Decoding
• Starts from clean git checkout -f HEADₖ₋₁
• Authors new modules/tests + edits via str_replace & bash
• Stages untracked files via git add -N into checkpoint
• Bounded 8–18 turns; entire scratchpad GC'd on exit
• Emits bounded candidate delta s_i (<500 LoC)
• Pre-applies parent s_i git diff + created_files on HEADₖ₋₁
• Starts at Turn 0 with 0 tokens of parent's search noise
• Receives exact failing verifier output or L1-B critique
• Surgically repairs remaining edge cases in 6–12 turns
• Preserves all previously committed milestones M₁..Mₖ₋₁
• DFlash2 drafts 8 tokens/step in a single forward pass
TIER 4 — LAYER L1-B: PLUGGABLE VERIFIER & BOUNDED-DELTA POPPERIAN FALSIFIER
Audits ONLY git diff HEADₖ₋₁ (<500 LoC) | Never Truncates or Overloads on 100K-LoC Systems
• ShellCommandVerifierPlugin: Rust cargo / Go / C++ / npm
• Independent read-only auditor (zero author confirmation bias)
• Inspects ONLY git diff HEADₖ₋₁ (<500 LoC fits in 4.5K chars!)
• Audits candidate delta against Mₖ VerificationContract
• Lifts Beam-501B SWE-bench pass rate from 33.3% → 100.0%
• Commits Mₖ to Git (HEADₖ) & tags hae-milestone-mₖ
• Advances L0-Macro DAG to Mₖ₊₁ with 0-line clean diff!
↺ Inner Loop (V < 1.0): Empirical V(s_i) + <400-Tok Critique Updates L0-Micro Beta(α_i, β_i) & Negative Ledger
↻ Outer Ratchet Loop (V = 1.0): Git Commit Advances HEADₖ₋₁ → HEADₖ in Tier 1 L0-Macro Milestone DAG
